faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: A few helpful details about finding people and building together on MOSAIQ.

items.question: What is MOSAIQ?
items.answer: MOSAIQ helps students discover peers with complementary skills, explore student-built projects, and find opportunities to work together.

items.question: Who can use MOSAIQ?
items.answer: The current experience is presented for Chitkara University students. The site displays student and project examples to help you explore the platform.

items.question: How can I discover other students?
items.answer: Open Discover Talent, then search by a student's name, skill, or university. You can also narrow the visible matches with the skill filters and select a profile to see its matching details.

items.question: How does student matching work?
items.answer: The matching view brings together student profiles and highlights relevant or complementary skills using the profiles shown in the experience. It is an exploratory guide, not a guarantee of compatibility or a scored ranking.

items.question: How do I explore or join a project?
items.answer: Use the project search, category, and technology filters to find an idea. Open a project card to read its details and any listed collaboration roles. The request button currently shows an on-page confirmation.

items.question: Can I showcase my skills and projects?
items.answer: Student cards can show a profile's skills, interests, projects, collaboration goals, and portfolio links. The current public experience is a showcase; account editing is not available here.

items.question: What happens when I select Connect?
items.answer: The matching view updates the selected profile's connection status in this browser. It does not start a chat or send a message from this public demo.

items.question: Are mentor and learning-resource features available?
items.answer: Mentors and Resources appear in the navigation, but their dedicated experiences are not currently available on this site.

items.question: How do I change the website language?
items.answer: Open the language menu in the navigation and choose English, हिन्दी, or ਪੰਜਾਬੀ. Your choice is saved in this browser and restored on your next visit.
